title: Theo and the Verdict
author: Felix Villalobos
blurb: Isandro Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
